items.title: Home Depot (HD) Jumped, What Is Driving Attention Now?
items.summary: Home Depot (HD) jumped back into the spotlight after the midterm elections, as investors reacted to a Democratic sweep in Congress and renewed hopes for lower borrowing costs and targeted housing affordability measures.
